## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Russian-language 2D game for phone and tablet: play as a mushroom, grow roots, defeat forest rivals, and capture the forest.

## Requirements
- Keep the mushroom the same size while its roots grow; root strikes defeat nearby enemies, and poisonous roots turn touched enemies green before they die.
- Include wolves, rabbits, bears, and moose; award 10 points per defeat; capture the forest and support phone/tablet touch controls.
- Use Russian interface text; make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Use a top-down forest with seven ancient stumps as capture objectives.
- Support joystick and on-screen attack buttons, plus WASD, Space, and E keyboard controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the responsive Russian-language interface and overlays in `index.html`, game styling in `style.css`, and gameplay loop in `game.js`.
- Added a three-second initial invulnerability window, reduced enemy notice radius to 260, and added a data-URI favicon to prevent the browser favicon 404.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser tests verified starting, touch attack button events, pause/resume, and visibility of controls.

### Active
- Fix mobile HUD overlap: at 390×844, the objective overlaps the health/root panels and minimap.
- Continue testing movement, attacks, stump capture, and victory/defeat screens in the browser.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Adjust mobile HUD layout so the health, roots, objective, minimap, and buttons do not overlap.
2. Re-test mobile and desktop rendering, movement, attacks, stump capture, pause, and result screens.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game interface, controls, overlays, and favicon.
- `style.css`: responsive layout and game styling.
- `game.js`: canvas rendering, game logic, controls, scoring, and states.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed the game files and helper scripts as untracked.
- Desktop browser testing previously reported a `/favicon.ico` 404; a data-URI favicon was added afterward, but the absence of the 404 has not yet been verified.
- A mobile gameplay screenshot was saved at `/tmp/opencode/game-mobile.jpg`.
